title: Intentional not-found responses produce an instant-validation error during prefetch
steps: Run a development server with Cache Components and partial prefetching enabled.
Visit a dynamic route with an unknown parameter whose page uses the standard not-found API.
Inspect the HTTP response and development diagnostics.
observed: The HTTP response correctly returns 404 with noindex.
Development output also reports an instant-validation failure caused by the intentional not-found response.
expected: An intentional not-found response should return 404 without being reported as an instant-validation failure.
